title: World Readable
summary: A staging box left a deploy token in a world-readable backup. The internal vault trusts whoever holds it.
objectives: Enumerate the box for readable configuration and backups
Use it to read the internal vault
learningOutcomes: Enumerate a host for unsecured credentials
Explain why secrets in world-readable files are dangerous even without privilege escalation
Recommend least-privilege file permissions and secret management

references.label: CWE-552: Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties
MITRE ATT&CK T1552.001: Credentials In Files

hints.bodyMd: Look for files everyone can read that shouldn't hold secrets. Try `grep -R VAULT /etc /var /opt /srv 2>/dev/null`, and look in `/var/backups`.

`/var/backups/deploy.env` holds `VAULT_TOKEN`. Send it to the vault as the `X-Vault-Token` header: `python3 -c "import urllib.request as u;print(u.urlopen(u.Request('http://vault:8080/',headers={'X-Vault-Token':'<token>'})).read().decode())"`.
